ModMetaData.name: The Rites
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
The liturgy tree: five rites the clan does not buy but is given, as the ship remembers. Scrap Shrine, Conduit Choir, God-Speaker Array, Liturgy of the Hull, and the day The Gods Speak Back.
Authored 2026-09-04 on the owner's ruling (RESEARCH_TREE_NORMALIZATION_1 rulings block). v1 ships the tab and the five ResearchProjectDefs, chained T0..T4. The revealed-not-bought gate (ship-memory grants, no ordinary research) is LATER work — until it lands these rows are researchable like any other, which is acceptable for review and wrong for shipping. Subspace gravitic penetration's flavor folds into the God-Speaker Array per design/Jawa/research_review/functionless_tech_candidates.md.
